subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw expose peer `sessions_send` run progress through a new caller-readable run-event API, and what authorization/redaction/retention contract must gate it?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent API shape crosses session, Gateway RPC, plugin/event, ACP, and channel security boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve a bounded run-event contract
options.body: Add an additive, permission-checked, redacted event observation surface and layer `sessions_subscribe` or an approved `sessions_send` option on top of it.

options.title: Defer to structured process events
options.body: Keep this issue open but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826 the design owner if maintainers want a broader process/step ledger first.

options.title: Keep final-only A2A delivery
options.body: Explicitly reject peer progress streaming for now and document `timeoutSeconds: 0`, `sessions_history`, and ACP parent-owned spawn streaming as the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded run-event contract
recommendation.body: Add an additive, permission-checked, redacted event observation surface and layer `sessions_subscribe` or an approved `sessions_send` option on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: Most current sessions_send, A2A, gateway event routing, and agent.wait history points to this owner path.
